title: Register and label water-using products before supply
what: Products covered by the WELS standard (such as taps, showers and toilets) must be registered and labelled before they are supplied.

laws.title: Water Efficiency Labelling and Standards Act 2005

sources.title: Water Efficiency Labelling and Standards Act 2005
sources.quote: 34 Supply of WELS products that are not WELS-labelled (1) A person contravenes this subsection if: (a) the person supplies a WELS product; and (b) the applicable WELS standard requires the WELS product to be WELS-labelled for the purposes of the supply; and (c) the product is not WELS-labelled.
